matching Evo2 train/validation/test X, y and w

extraction_provenance.limit: Current defaults do not prove the exact historical code revision/layer; saved-feature metric agreement is not a new GPU DNA-to-embedding audit.

remaining_limits: Original optional calib_xs maps/cohort and T22_xs predictions are unavailable; these are not dependencies of the deployed raw-score/rank path.
The known 888 wrong-assembly B. licheniformis positive labels remain in deployed training; recovery/card updates do not repair the models.

Exact historical Evo2 extraction code/layer, imported six-base QC PWM scientific source and the uncommitted _seq enrichment generator remain separate evidence boundaries. Original mining MEME/FIMO scan records are recovered.
No fresh GPU extraction, model training or target/paired-benchmark rescanning is claimed.
Promoter activity, sigma-factor usage, constitutive/inducible regulation, strength and downstream cotranscription require independent experimental evidence.
Model repositories remain private; this compact record does not archive the large recovered inputs or the complete project wiki/docs.
